manifest_scope: public analysis contract and reported execution summary

required_files.name: OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1.csv
required_files.role: log1p TPM expression used to define proxy groups

input_contract.runtime_provenance: Notebook 05 writes the selected filenames, numeric thresholds, group counts, and SHA-256 hashes to results_v8/05_biology_validation/depmap_manifest.json.

thresholds.ESR1_median: median ESR1 expression across eligible breast-lineage cell lines
thresholds.PGR_median: median PGR expression across eligible breast-lineage cell lines
thresholds.ERBB2_q75: 75th percentile of ERBB2 expression across eligible breast-lineage cell lines

hierarchical_assignment.rule: not ERBB2-high and (ESR1 > ESR1_median or PGR > PGR_median)

interpretation_boundary.description: The three groups are relative-expression proxies used only for the orthogonal cell-line dependency analysis.

dependency_analysis.contrast: proxy group minus the remaining eligible breast-lineage lines
dependency_analysis.more_negative_means: greater dependency in the focal proxy group

mean_effect_FDR_family.composition: 4 class networks x 2 panel definitions x 3 proxy groups

reported_basal_like_strict_core.conclusion: No uniform selective-dependency signal was supported in the ESR1/PGR-low proxy group.
